topic: Bounded enemy obstacle routing and local crowd occupancy
scope: Same harness and 15 scenarios; one warmup plus five rounds per runtime. Built library and installed dependencies unchanged.
CPU-only observations. Changed movement deliberately changes subsequent combat, RNG consumption and population; no equivalent-gameplay speedup claim.
Eight grunt enemies, stationary player. Concave wall: 4800 ticks; one-sided open crowd: 2400 ticks. Attacks disabled in these two locomotion fixtures.
Arrivals are first ticks on the far side of the wall within three units of the player; zero means not reached. Overlap counts pairs with penetration greater than 0.05.
blockedActorTicks includes deliberate waiting at destinations, not solely obstruction. Soft separation does not guarantee zero overlap in narrow or saturated crowds.
Full-capacity crowd CPU increases; median budget passes do not guarantee the worst tick meets the 120 Hz deadline. Real target-device GPU acceptance is separate.
